## Solo Exhibitions at Moderna Museet Stockholm in 2022:

1. **Hilma af Klint** - "The Ten Largest" (September 22, 2022 – January 8, 2023)
   - **Deceased**: Yes (died October 21, 1944, after a traffic accident in Stockholm at age 81)

2. **Sara Sejin Chang (Sara van der Heide)** - "Four Months, Four Million Light Years" (November 11, 2022 – August 20, 2023)
   - **Deceased**: No (born 1977, Korean-Dutch artist, still alive)

3. **Nan Goldin** - "This Will Not End Well" (October 29, 2022 – February 26, 2023)
   - **Deceased**: No (born 1953, American photographer, still alive)

4. **Jeppe Hein** - "Who are you really?" (May 21, 2022 – August 28, 2022)
   - **Deceased**: No (Danish artist born 1979, still alive)

5. **Korakrit Arunanondchai** - "From dying to living" (September 17, 2022 – April 9, 2023)
   - **Deceased**: No (Thai-born Singaporean artist born 1983, still alive)

6. **Every Ocean Hughes** - "Alive time" (March 1 – April 17, 2022)
   - **Deceased**: No (contemporary performance artist)

## Answer:

Only **one** special exhibition featuring a deceased artist was shown at Moderna Museet Stockholm in 2022:

**Hilma af Klint** - "*The Ten Largest*" (September 22, 2022 – January 8, 2023)

Hilma af Klint (1862–1944) was one of Sweden's most important modernist artists, known for being among the first creators of abstract art. Her work remained largely unseen until decades after her death, and this exhibition brought together some of her largest and most significant paintings.

Based on my research of Moderna Museet Stockholm's 2022 exhibition program, there were several special exhibitions focusing on singular artists that year. Let me identify which featured artists who were deceased at the time of the exhibition.

1. **Hilma af Klint** - "The Ten Largest" (September 22, 2022 – January 8, 2023)
   - **Deceased**: Yes (died October 21, 1944, after a traffic accident in Stockholm at age 81)

2. **Sara Sejin Chang (Sara van der Heide)** - "Four Months, Four Million Light Years" (November 11, 2022 – August 20, 2023)
   - **Deceased**: No (born 1977, Korean-Dutch artist, still alive)

3. **Nan Goldin** - "This Will Not End Well" (October 29, 2022 – February 26, 2023)
   - **Deceased**: No (born 1953, American photographer, still alive)

4. **Jeppe Hein** - "Who are you really?" (May 21, 2022 – August 28, 2022)

5. **Korakrit Arunanondchai** - "From dying to living" (September 17, 2022 – April 9, 2023)
   - **Deceased**: No (Thai-born Singaporean artist born 1983, still alive)

6. **Every Ocean Hughes** - "Alive time" (March 1 – April 17, 2022)
   - **Deceased**: No (contemporary performance artist)

## Answer:

Only **one** special exhibition featuring a deceased artist was shown at Moderna Museet Stockholm in 2022:

**Hilma af Klint** - "*The Ten Largest*" (September 22, 2022 – January 8, 2023)

Hilma af Klint (1862–1944) was one of Sweden's most important modernist artists, known for being among the first creators of abstract art. Her work remained largely unseen until decades after her death, and this exhibition brought together some of her largest and most significant paintings.
